recommended_narrative.demonstration: Use an original static architecture illustration or an explicitly synthetic local event demonstration. No live market connectivity is needed.
recommended_narrative.outcome: A source-backed example of integrating systems programming with full-stack product workflows. Do not imply measured trading returns or validated scalability.

uncertainties: Resume and supplied task establish relevant professional context; exact individual contribution to every service is unverified. Avoid sole-author or complete ownership claims.

README capacity numbers and claims of no lookahead or perfect backtest parity were not independently tested. Omit numerical capacity, profitability and correctness guarantees.
Graph report contains many inferred edges and was used only as required navigation context; source claims above are based on manifests and direct source slices.

Medicine lookup filters by name and species, with distinct names and species supplied for selection.

recommended_narrative.headline: Make a specialist reference easier to work with.

recommended_narrative.outcome: An implemented local records workflow bridging a familiar spreadsheet format and a focused desktop interface.

uncertainties: No clinical validation, adoption counts, user interviews, measured time savings or runtime tests were performed.
Resume supports the project; exact independent/team ownership is not independently audited.

No public source URL verified.
selected.publication_boundary: Discuss software organization and workflow; do not publish medical advice, patient/client data, real medicine datasets or private source.
